Ananya Chauhan | ananya.chauhan917@example.com | +91 9945683980 | Remote

Results-driven accounting professional with strong experience in financial reporting, compliance and accounts payable processes.

Senior Accountant, UrbanPantry — Feb 2025 - Present
Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable workflow for a 120-person foodtech startup; implemented automated three-way match that reduced invoice processing time by 45% and improved vendor payment accuracy. Lead monthly GST reconciliations and filing, identifying and correcting discrepancies that recovered Rs. 2.1M in input credit. Prepare IFRS-aligned journal entries and support quarter-end close, standardizing recurring entries and reducing close cycle by 2 days. Regularly use Jira to track accounting tasks and Git for version control of financial models and templates.

Accountant, Swiggy — Aug 2021 - Jan 2025
Prepared IFRS-compliant financial schedules for regional business units and supported external audit queries, contributing to clean audit opinions. Managed statutory TDS compliance across vendor payments, implementing process controls that cut TDS-related exceptions by 60%. Built and maintained Financial Modelling templates for scenario planning of promotions and delivery economics, enabling leadership to assess margin impact of new initiatives. Coordinated with AP team to streamline vendor onboarding and payment cadence.

Accountant, Vertex Analytics — Jun 2014 - Jul 2021
Owned Accounts Payable operations for a data analytics services firm, processing monthly vendor payments, reconciliations and accruals. Managed day-to-day bookkeeping in Tally, ensuring ledgers were accurate and timely for billing cycles. Administered TDS computations and filings, reducing late-payment penalties through improved tracking. Worked with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements and tracked issues in Jira.

Skills: Tally, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable, IFRS, Financial Modelling, Git, Jira

Education: B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
